description: Engine status evaluator rules (card M2-01, P Part 4 Step 2.2, DECISIONS D4). Limits themselves live in configs/engines/<id>.json 'limits'; this file holds only the evaluator's rule constants and the channel -> subsystem map.

exit_margin_fraction_of_band.ref: P Step 2.2 hysteresis: exit only after the value is back inside the band by 2 % of the band span

exit_hold_s.ref: P Step 2.2 hysteresis: ... for 10 s (simulated seconds, D8)

hypothesis_posterior_min.ref: P Step 2.2: a hypothesis with posterior >= 0.7 sets that fault's status_at_full_severity

subsystems.ref: channel -> subsystem, for 'two quarantined sensors on the same subsystem -> CAUTION' (P Step 2.2)

max_shelve_s.ref: longest shelve before automatic un-shelve (U3 / ISA-18.2 shelving with a time limit); NO-GO alerts cannot be shelved

alert_actions.ref: operator action per reason code (U3: every alert has an action, else it is an event). Fault-specific actions come from the registry mitigation via the hypothesis (M3).
alert_actions.ENGINE_FAILED: Engine not running: follow the engine-failure / restart checklist; select a landing site.
alert_actions.LIMIT_WARNING_HIGH: Above the operating limit: reduce power now and land as soon as practicable.
alert_actions.LIMIT_WARNING_LOW: Below the operating limit: reduce power now and land as soon as practicable.
alert_actions.LIMIT_CAUTION_HIGH: Outside the normal range: reduce power or increase cooling airflow and watch the trend.
alert_actions.LIMIT_CAUTION_LOW: Outside the normal range: check the trend and the related readings; adjust power.
alert_actions.TIME_LIMIT: Time-limited power exceeded: reduce to maximum continuous power.
alert_actions.TIME_TO_LIMIT: Predicted to reach a limit before the mission ends: plan to reduce power or return early.
alert_actions.SENSORS_QUARANTINED: Several sensors of one subsystem are not trusted: cross-check, treat the subsystem as unmonitored.
alert_actions.SENSOR_QUARANTINED: Sensor not trusted: use the related readings; schedule a sensor check.
alert_actions.HYPOTHESIS: Suspected fault: see the diagnosis for the recommended action.
alert_actions.LATCHED: A NO-GO occurred: review the cause and acknowledge before the next flight.
